name: 86 Chaos 16.0.59 Partial Publish and Schedule Reassign Guard Fix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.59 Partial Publish and Schedule Reassign Guard Fix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.59 Partial Publish and Schedule Reassign Guard Fix
notes: Schedule Builder Publish now opens a week-selection dialog so managers can publish selected weeks or the full schedule.
Deleted shift markers now track real Firestore document IDs only for saved shifts, preventing a deleted shift from being restored when a new overlapping shift is added for the same employee and day.
Schedule delete/reassign, menu costing, protected root admin, and release-gate fixes from earlier versions are preserved.
